data.title: bn-1w4h: teach mess-cli the .seal and .refuted sealed namespaces
data.description: doctor/verify/backup/retention/inspect/rebuild now classify sealed segments the way the engine does (.seal pack over shadowed .pidx), report bn-30u *.refuted quarantine artifacts read-only, and the backup cut carries the .seal pack (bn-11g's footer identity makes the cut identity-complete or restore fails its own verify gate). 19 new acceptance tests in crates/mess-cli/tests/seal_namespace.rs plus pack variants in retention_explain/inspect_report_shape/rebuild_byte_equal.
